rank_one_higher_power_summary.proved_single_coordinate_lift_criterion: For p in H_m, the proved v_p(V_m)>=e_p+1 implies p^2|c_m iff p^2|U_m.  If delta is 1 when p is in the rank-zero Cartier product and 0 otherwise, then exactly v_p(U_m)=v_p(q_p A_m)-delta, so the criterion is q_p A_m=0 mod p^(2+delta).
